objective_value: <float> Total expected cost across the scenario tree, combining capital investment expenditures and expected operational costs.
alpha: <dict> Complete generator commitment variables keyed by scenario-tree node, representative day, lower-level scenario, hour, and generator.
gamma: <dict> Complete generator startup variables using the same composite key convention.
p_gen: <dict> Complete generator dispatch variables in MW.
s_res: <dict> Complete generator reserve variables in MW.
f_fwd: <dict> Complete forward transmission-flow variables in MW.
f_bwd: <dict> Complete backward transmission-flow variables in MW.

<scenario_node_id>.generators: <dict, key: '{generator_id}'> Whether each candidate generator is built at this scenario tree node (1 = build, 0 = do not build).
<scenario_node_id>.lines: <dict, key: '{line_id}'> Whether each candidate transmission line is built at this scenario tree node (1 = build, 0 = do not build).
<scenario_node_id>.storage: <dict, key: '{storage_id}'> Whether each candidate storage unit is built at this scenario tree node (1 = build, 0 = do not build).
